newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rican inflation 1.09 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rican inflation 1.09 pct in March.

text.p: Costa Rica's consumer price index rose 1.09 percent in March from 0.63 percent in February, the Economy Ministry said on Monday.
Accumulated inflation in the first three months of the year was 3.82 percent, up from 2.87 percent in the same period in 1996, Economy Minister Jose Leon Desanti added in a news conference.
Driving up inflation in March were higher milk, rice and soft drinks prices, he said.
The ministry said accumulated inflation from March 1996 to March 1997 was 14.9 percent.
